name: Byouin Adventure: Kariguwae no Arie-sensei
original_name: 病院アドベンチャー カリ咥えの有恵先生
source:
There's a rumour spreading among the patients of Himegaoka Hospital. 
Three hard-edged patients take on the challenge of discovering it! 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE068466.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
姬丘岡醫院的患者之間流傳著一個傳聞。三名個性鮮明的病人決定挑戰這個謎團，查出真相！

[來源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE068466.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
